verdict.rationale: Ramp's own docs describe the full flow this story asks for: a vendor invoice is dragged into Ramp, matched to its PO, coded, routed for approval, and paid. This is backed by dynamic approval routing, the Bill Payments API for paying vendors end-to-end, and CLI bill pending/approve commands. Missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on configuring bill-specific approval chains (the routing evidence is mostly marketing-level), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the bill upload-to-approval-to-pay flow.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can upload bills and route them through an approval workflow before paying vendors

citations.quote: A vendor invoice is dragged into Ramp, automatically matched to its PO, coded to the right GL account, routed for approval, and paid
Dynamic approval routing with parallel workflows across finance, IT, legal, and security
Create approved bills via the API, attach documents, choose a payment method, and pay vendors end-to-end
Unlimited free same-day ACH and international wires for bill payments
